hookQuestion.text: What does a ghost pepper do inside you?
hookQuestion.shownBy: Bild 1: Kerl mit dampfenden Ohren + Pepper
hookQuestion.answer: Capsaicin schaltet den Hitzesensor TRPV1 – und am nächsten Morgen am Ausgang wieder.

finalImage.image: Kerl hält zwei Ghost Peppers hoch (Pose wie Hook)

soundBed.why: Club-Bass innen, Sirenen in panic, Piep über dem Schrei am Morgen.

scenes.text: This guy just ate a *ghost* pepper. | His tongue filed a *complaint*.
scenes.visual: COVER 0–0,5 s: Big white-headed guy, cheeks red, steam from ears, half-eaten ghost pepper in hand, '>< ' eyes. Shot 2: tongue (with tiny face) slaps a complaint form on the counter.
Camera dives down the throat into a neon nightclub street; Capsaicin (red molecule ball with fedora, shades, gold chain) struts out of a pepper limo, kicks a saliva drop aside.

scenes.text: He walks up to TRPV1, | your heat sensor. | Its one job? | Yell when it's *painfully* hot.
scenes.visual: Club entrance 'TRPV1 – HEAT ONLY'; bouncer = big ion-channel door with tiny face and thermometer; Capsaicin flashes a fake ID 'I AM 43°C'.

scenes.text: But he brings no heat. | He just flips the *switch*. | The brain reads *fire* | and signs it unread.
scenes.visual: Shot 1: Capsaicin yanks a big lever 'HEAT', bouncer's eyes go wide. Shot 2: Brain office (bureaucrat brain with glasses, coffee) stamps 'FIRE!!' without looking, sign 'NO THINKING AFTER 5PM'.
Shot 1: alarm lights in the body-factory, tiny cells running with buckets. Shot 2: outside, guy chugging water from a hose, crying waterfalls. Shot 3: push-in on his face 'It's you'.

scenes.text: Next *morning*. | Same sensors, | waiting at the *exit*.
scenes.visual: Shot 1: bathroom at dawn, guy on toilet, calm. Shot 2: down below, a second TRPV1 bouncer with the same face at a door 'EXIT', cracking knuckles; Capsaicin waves 'Hi again'. Shot 3: guy's face explodes, speech bubble '#@%&!' + bleep.
Guy at a market stall, sweaty, holding up two ghost peppers with a dead-eyed smile – same pose as the hook (loop).

note: 74 Skriptwörter, 7 Szenen, Ziel 29–31 s inkl. End-Card 1,5 s.
